answer: An autonomous AI agent economy can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring reputation to a cryptographic orchard of zero-knowledge proofs tethered to hardware secure enclaves. To forge a legitimate network identity, an attacker must expend quantifiable computational work and stake capital, rendering the marginal cost of spawning fake agents economically prohibitive. This creates a computational mesa where only genuine, resource-backed actors sustain long-term viability.
